label: Старуха
description: A 10-sentence usage card for старуха (old woman).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Старуха' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'сидит'. 'У окна' is a genitive location, painting a quiet domestic scene.

Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Старуху' is the accusative direct object of 'увидел'. Being animate feminine, it takes the regular feminine accusative ending. 'На скамейке' is a prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Старухи' is the genitive in the frame 'у старухи' to show possession. 'Доброе сердце' is the nominative subject of the implied existence.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Старухе' is the dative governed by 'помогать', which takes a dative object. The infinitive 'нести' explains the help offered.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Старухой' is the instrumental required by 'гордиться'. 'Своей' is the agreeing feminine instrumental possessive.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О старухе' uses the prepositional 'старухе' after 'о' to express the topic of conversation. 'Вчера' adds the time.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with dative. 'Старуха' is the nominative subject of 'рассказала'. 'Нам' is the dative recipient and 'сказку' the accusative object.

missions.phrase: Я подошёл к старухе у двери.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К старухе' uses the dative 'старухе' after 'к' to show movement toward her. 'У двери' is a genitive location.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. After 'две', the feminine noun takes the genitive singular 'старухи'. 'На лавочке' is a prepositional location placing the women on a bench.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Старухи' is the nominative plural subject of 'кормили'. 'Голубей' is the animate accusative plural object, and 'в парке' is a location.
